After Gabi reads the Muertoons a spooky story, everyone is chilled to the bone except Bibi. Bibi thinks scary stories are silly and says nothing can scare her. Though Bibi may discover that she is not be as brave as she thinks she is when a mysterious creature sneaks into their home.
Want to achieve Harley Quinn hair without dying your precious locks? Here are two ways to do it!

The Film Maker is the next big thing when it comes to wildlife documentaries. There's no monster too big or too scary for him to try to film. But like every expert pushing the boundaries, there's always a challenge waiting for him just around the corner.
The Grown Up Monster is teaching his class of monster children. Unfortunately, one of them is being more monstrous than all the others: the Whoopee Cushion Monster. He just won't stay still!

Isamu and Zo Zo Zombie encounter Hipster Zombie in the cemetery, and decide to have Zo Zo teach him the zombie ropes. Hipster Zombie is a millennial know-it-all, though, and a lousy student, and before long it's time to go back in his coffin.

Mad professor Dr. Hanouri asks Zo Zo and Isamu to keep an eye on his lab for a while, but they can’t resist playing with his newest invention: the Multiplier Gun! Soon there are hundreds of duplicate Zo Zos running amok.
Shy Capricorn turns into a fierce protector when he’s wrapped inside your love.
Enjoy Om Nom and his halloween special!
